title: AI Baby Dance Video
summary: Make an AI baby dance video from one picture: a cute baby bouncing and clapping to the beat, the exact prompts behind it and six clips to copy. Free in Flick.
body_markdown:
### How do I make an AI baby dance video?


Generate or upload a full body picture of the baby as the start frame of an image to video model, describe a small bouncy dance with the feet planted and a static camera, and generate a short clip.


### Is there a free AI baby dance video generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, enough to make a baby picture and animate it into a short dancing clip.


### Can I make my own baby dance with AI?


Yes. Start from a clear, full body photo of your child standing on a safe surface, keep the dance small and gentle, and share the clip privately with family and friends, since it shows a real child.


### What kind of picture works best for an AI baby dance?


A sharp, well lit picture with the whole baby in frame from head to feet, standing and facing the camera, with some empty space on both sides works best, because the model needs room to move the arms and knees.


### How do I keep the baby's face the same in the dance?


Keep the movement simple, keep the camera still, and end the prompt with same baby, same outfit, same place, then generate again if the face changes during the dance.


### Can I add music to an AI baby dance video?


Yes. Make the clip first, then add a song when you post it, or generate a music track in Flick to go with it, and line the bounces up with the beat of the music.
